_doc: The play actions this world registers. Each becomes a / command (in green); typing it is the same as the player saying that prompt line themselves, with {args} replaced by whatever follows the command. Names use letters / digits / hyphens and must not clash with the built-in commands. Also: the `san` key only swaps the description of pct's mental check tool (this world calls it “Nerve”); the op name stays the same.

actions.prompt: I go up to {args} and speak.

actions.help: Look around and see what is here
actions.prompt: I look carefully about me, taking note of the people and things here.
